def comps(g, val=2):
    m=g==val; lab,n=ndimage.label(m, structure=np.ones((3,1)))
    out=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        cs=np.argwhere(lab==i)

        r0,r1,c0,c1=rs.min(),rs.max(),cs_.min(),cs_.max()
        sub=m[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1].copy()

        out.append((lab[i].tolist(), r0, c0, len(best), best))
    return out

from scipy import ndimage

for i in range(1,8):
    inp=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']); out=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])

# Feature candidates and targets

import numpy as np, json
def get_strict_comps(inp):
    # 4-connectivity
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0]); seen=set(); res=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if inp[r][c]==2 and (r,c) not in seen:
                st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]; seen.add((r,c))
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                        q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W and inp[q[0]][q[1]]==2 and q not in seen:
                            seen.add(q); st.append(q)
                res.append(comp)
    return res

import numpy as np, json
# Best supported rule from 7 demos:
# - each 2x3 T/invT component maps to ONE output cell:
#   y = floor((r0+0.5)*3/H), x = floor((c0+0.5)*6/W)
#   value = 3 if output-column would be even else 1  (fits every demo's slot values)
# - collisions: later component in reading order overwrites
def f(inp):
    inp=np.array(inp); H,W=inp.shape
    ys=set(np.argwhere(inp==2))
    seen=set(); out=[]
    while len(seen)<len(ys):
        p=min(ys-seen)
        st=[p]; comp=[p]; seen.add(p)
        while st:
            y,x=p
            for dy in(-1,0,1):
                for dx in(-1,0,1):
                    q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if q in ys and q not in seen:
                        seen.add(q); st.append(q); comp.append(q)
        out.append(comp)
    res=np.zeros((3,6),dtype=int)
    order=[]
    for comp in out:
        r0=min(p[0] for p in comp); c0=min(p[1] for p in comp)
        cy=sum(p[0] for p in comp)/len(comp); cx=sum(p[1] for p in comp)/len(comp)
        y=int(np.floor(cy*3/H)); x=int(np.floor(cx*6/W))
        v=3 if x%2==0 else 1
        order.append((comp,y,x,v))
    for comp,y,x,v in order:
        res[y,x]=v
    return res.tolist()
ok=True
for i in range(1,8):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])
    r=f(gi)
    m=r==go.tolist()
    print(i,m); ok&=m
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
